Copied from the pdfjs-dist npm package: legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs, legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs (the legacy build polyfills newer JS for older browsers), cmaps/, standard_fonts/.
Renamed .mjs to .js so every browser serves them as JavaScript from the extension.
